sentences.zh: 她已經幫十二位客人辦好入住了。

sentences.en: Your room there has already been paid for, and a taxi's been called.
They'll be added as if you'd stayed here.
It's all been emailed to you.
Do you know if the new dashboards are ready yet?
Mei has been sorting out the access problem all morning, and it's nearly done.
The old reports were moved last week, so the links you saved don't work anymore.
Could you tell me where we are with the campaign data?
Do you know if there's anything I can do to speed it up?
Thanks for the heads-up. I'll loop in my manager.
I was wondering what your usual turnaround time is.
Where is the latest version? → Could you tell me where the latest version is?
sentences.zh: 最新版本在哪裡？→ 可以告訴我最新版本在哪裡嗎？

sentences.en: When did they send the file? → Do you know when they sent the file?
sentences.zh: 他們什麼時候寄出檔案的？→ 你知道他們什麼時候寄出檔案的嗎？

sentences.en: Is the dashboard working? → Do you know if the dashboard is working?
sentences.zh: 儀表板正常嗎？→ 你知道儀表板是不是正常嗎？

sentences.en: Do you know when the data team will update the dashboard?
sentences.zh: 你知道資料團隊什麼時候會更新儀表板嗎？

sentences.en: Could you tell me if this file is the latest version?
sentences.zh: 可以告訴我這個檔案是不是最新的版本嗎？

sentences.en: Mei has already finished three reports, but she has been working on the fourth one since this morning.
sentences.zh: Mei 已經做完三份報告了，但她從今天早上就一直在處理第四份。

sentences.en: So far, twelve requests have been carried over to the next sprint.
sentences.zh: 到目前為止，已經有十二個需求被延到下一個衝刺週期。

sentences.en: Could you tell me who actually signs off on the data before it reaches us?
Two people each thought the other one had it, and we waited four days.
They said the new servers had been shipped and were on their way.
Jake has been testing the checkout page on older phones since Monday.
I think the new reports are clearer than the old ones were.
The design team said the homepage was finished.
Lena told me they would wrap up testing by Friday.
The developers said they had sorted out the login bug.
Two decisions are still pending, so I'll update you next week.
"The homepage is finished." → The designers said the homepage was finished.
sentences.zh: 「首頁完成了。」→ 設計師說首頁已經完成了。

sentences.en: "We'll wrap up testing by Friday." → Lena said they would wrap up testing by Friday.
sentences.zh: 「我們星期五前會把測試收尾。」→ Lena 說他們會在星期五前把測試收尾。

sentences.en: "We've sorted out the login bug." → The developers said they had sorted out the login bug.
sentences.zh: 「我們解決了登入的錯誤。」→ 工程師說他們已經解決了登入的錯誤。

sentences.en: "We're working on the mobile version." → They told me they were working on the mobile version.
sentences.zh: 「我們正在做手機版。」→ 他們跟我說他們正在做手機版。

sentences.en: Lena said they would finish testing by Friday.
sentences.zh: Lena 說他們會在星期五前完成測試。

sentences.en: Last week, the client said they were happy with the new design.
sentences.zh: 客戶上週說他們對新設計很滿意。

sentences.en: Could you tell me when the budget request will be approved?
sentences.zh: 可以告訴我預算申請什麼時候會被核准嗎？

sentences.en: We have already finished two reports, but we have been working on the third one since Monday.
sentences.zh: 我們已經寫完兩份報告了，但從星期一開始就一直在做第三份。

sentences.en: The vendor said the API would slip by a week, so we've moved the testing around.
She'll panic a lot more if she hears it from the client first.
They help for a few hours, but then the pain comes right back.
Your muscles are stiff, and your posture isn't helping.
My manager has been telling me the same thing, and she's usually right.
The doctor suggested taking a short walk every hour.
She recommended that I start physical therapy twice a week.
My co-worker insisted on driving me to the clinic.
He denied lifting anything heavy at the gym.
"Why don't you take a short walk every hour?" → The doctor suggested taking a short walk every hour.
sentences.zh: 「你何不每小時走一走？」→ 醫生建議每小時散步一下。

sentences.en: "You should start physical therapy." → She recommended that he start physical therapy twice a week.
sentences.zh: 「你應該開始做物理治療。」→ 她建議他每週做兩次物理治療。

sentences.en: "I'm driving you there. No arguments." → Mia insisted on driving him to the clinic.
sentences.zh: 「我載你去，不准拒絕。」→ Mia 堅持要載他去診所。

sentences.en: "I didn't lift anything at the gym." → Daniel denied lifting anything heavy at the gym.
sentences.zh: 「我在健身房沒搬任何東西。」→ Daniel 否認在健身房搬過重物。

sentences.en: The doctor suggested that I get up and walk around every hour.
sentences.zh: 醫生建議我每小時起來走一走。

sentences.en: My wife insisted on driving me to the clinic.
sentences.zh: 我太太堅持要載我去診所。

sentences.en: Do you know if that clinic is open on weekends?
sentences.zh: 你知道那家診所週末有沒有看診嗎？

sentences.en: I've already had two physical therapy sessions, and I've been doing stretches every morning since Monday.
sentences.zh: 我已經做過兩次物理治療了，而且從星期一開始每天早上都在做伸展。

sentences.en: She said it's fine, but it's not some magic fix.
But you're the one who's been limping around the kitchen since Monday.

grammar.q: I was wondering ___ you could help me with the budget report.
grammar.explain_zh: I was wondering 後面用 if 或 whether 帶出一個子句。
grammar.point: Polite requests: I was wondering if… / Would it be possible to…
grammar.point_zh: 委婉請求：I was wondering if… ／ Would it be possible to…

grammar.q: Would you mind ___ the door? It's a bit noisy outside.
grammar.explain_zh: Would you mind 後面接 V-ing：Would you mind closing…?
grammar.point: Polite requests: I was wondering if… / Would it be possible to…
grammar.point_zh: 委婉請求：I was wondering if… ／ Would it be possible to…

grammar.q: Which request sounds the most polite in an email to a senior manager?
options: I was wondering if we could move the deadline to Friday.
You need to move the deadline.
grammar.explain_zh: I was wondering if we could… 用過去進行式＋could，語氣最委婉。
grammar.point: Polite requests: I was wondering if… / Would it be possible to…
grammar.point_zh: 委婉請求：I was wondering if… ／ Would it be possible to…

grammar.q: Would it be possible ___ (extend) the deadline by two days?
grammar.explain_zh: Would it be possible + to + 原形動詞。
grammar.point: Polite requests: I was wondering if… / Would it be possible to…
grammar.point_zh: 委婉請求：I was wondering if… ／ Would it be possible to…

grammar.q: A colleague asks, "Would you mind if I joined the meeting?" You are happy for them to join. What do you say?
grammar.explain_zh: mind 是「介意」。回答 Not at all（一點也不介意）才是「可以」。
grammar.point: Polite requests: I was wondering if… / Would it be possible to…
grammar.point_zh: 委婉請求：I was wondering if… ／ Would it be possible to…

grammar.q: We ___ the new dashboard to all users last Monday.
grammar.explain_zh: 有明確過去時間 last Monday，要用過去簡單式 rolled out。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式

grammar.q: So far this week, we ___ (fix) twelve bugs.
grammar.explain_zh: So far this week（到目前為止）表示期間還沒結束，用現在完成式 have fixed。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式

grammar.q: Which sentence is correct?
options: I have sent the report yesterday.
I have send the report yesterday.
grammar.explain_zh: yesterday 是明確過去時間，不能和現在完成式連用，所以是 I sent the report yesterday。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式

grammar.q: Legal still ___ (not / sign) off on the contract, so we can't start.
grammar.explain_zh: still … not 表示到現在還沒發生，主詞 Legal 視為單數，用 hasn't signed。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式

grammar.q: A: "When did you finish the migration?" B: "We ___ it on Wednesday night."
grammar.explain_zh: 問句用 When did…，問的是過去的時間點，回答也用過去式 finished。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式

grammar.q: I ___ (feel) dizzy since I got up this morning.
grammar.explain_zh: since 早上起床到現在都在持續，用 have been + V-ing。
grammar.point: Present perfect continuous for ongoing situations
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成進行式：描述「從過去到現在一直在持續」的狀況

grammar.q: "How long ___ this cough?" the doctor asked.
grammar.explain_zh: How long 問持續到現在的時間，用現在完成進行式。這裡 have 是「出現症狀」的動作意思，可以用進行式；have you had 也可以，但選項中只有 B 正確。
grammar.point: Present perfect continuous for ongoing situations
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成進行式：描述「從過去到現在一直在持續」的狀況

grammar.q: Which sentence is correct?
options: I've been knowing my doctor for ten years.
I've known my doctor for ten years.
I'm knowing my doctor for ten years.
I know my doctor since ten years.
grammar.explain_zh: know 是狀態動詞，不用進行式；持續到現在用現在完成式 have known + for。
grammar.point: Present perfect continuous for ongoing situations
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成進行式：描述「從過去到現在一直在持續」的狀況

grammar.q: My knee ___ (hurt) on and off for a month, so I finally booked an appointment.
grammar.explain_zh: 主詞 My knee 是第三人稱單數，用 has been hurting；for a month 表示持續到現在。
grammar.point: Present perfect continuous for ongoing situations
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成進行式：描述「從過去到現在一直在持續」的狀況

grammar.q: Choose the best answer: "You look exhausted." — "I know. I ___ late every night this week."
grammar.explain_zh: this week 還沒結束，而且「看起來很累」是這陣子持續加班的結果，用現在完成進行式最自然。
grammar.point: Present perfect continuous for ongoing situations
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成進行式：描述「從過去到現在一直在持續」的狀況

grammar.q: Which sentence focuses on HOW MANY, not on the ongoing activity?
options: I've been taking painkillers all week.
grammar.explain_zh: 有具體次數／數量（four painkillers）時用現在完成式 have taken，強調結果；其他三句都在描述持續的狀態或動作。
grammar.point: Present perfect continuous for ongoing situations
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成進行式：描述「從過去到現在一直在持續」的狀況

grammar.q: I ___ the doctor last Tuesday, and she ___ me some eye drops.
grammar.explain_zh: last Tuesday 是明確的過去時間點，兩個動作都已結束，都用過去式。看到明確過去時間（yesterday、last…、ago、in 2024）就用過去式。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去式

grammar.q: I ___ (never / need) a referral before, so I'm not sure how it works.
grammar.explain_zh: 到目前為止的人生經驗、沒有特定時間點，用現在完成式；never 放在 have 和 p.p. 之間。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去式

grammar.q: Which sentence is correct?
options: I've had the flu two weeks ago.
I had the flu two weeks ago, but I've felt fine since then.
I had the flu two weeks ago, but I felt fine since then.
I've had the flu two weeks ago, but I felt fine since then.
grammar.explain_zh: two weeks ago 用過去式 had；since then 是「從那時到現在」，用現在完成式 have felt。一句裡兩種時態各管各的時間。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去式

grammar.q: ___ we split the work into two phases? (提議：我們何不…？)
grammar.explain_zh: Why don't we + 原形動詞？是友善的提議，don't 放在 we 前面（不是 Why we don't）。
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: I'd suggest that she ___ the client before Friday.
grammar.explain_zh: I'd suggest that + 主詞 + 原形動詞：that 子句的動詞用原形，主詞是 she 也不加 s，所以是 call（美式與正式英文的標準用法；英式也常說 should call）。不要因為有 I'd 就改成過去式 called；suggest 不接 to call，that 子句裡也不能只放 calling。
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: Which sentence is correct?
options: I suggest you to update the timeline.
I'd suggest to update the timeline.
I suggest you updating the timeline.
grammar.explain_zh: suggest 後面接名詞、V-ing 或 that 子句（that 可省略：I'd suggest you update…），不接 to V，也不接「人 + to V」或「人 + V-ing」。正確是 I'd suggest updating…
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: How about ___ (move) the review to Thursday?
grammar.explain_zh: How about / What about 後面接 V-ing。
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: You're in a meeting with a senior manager from another department. Which suggestion sounds the most polite?
options: We have to change the plan.
I'd suggest that we take another look at the plan.
Why you don't change the plan?
grammar.explain_zh: I'd suggest that we… 語氣委婉又正式。「We have to change the plan.」和「Change the plan.」聽起來像命令；「Why you don't change the plan?」語序錯誤，應該是 Why don't you…?
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: I'd suggest that he ___ (touch) base with the design team before the next milestone.
grammar.explain_zh: suggest that 子句用原形動詞，主詞是 he 也不加 s：touch base（美式與正式英文；英式常說 should touch，也算對）。
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: We ___ (work) on this proposal since September, and it still isn't finished.
grammar.explain_zh: since September 到現在還在做（still isn't finished），用 have been + V-ing。
grammar.point: Present perfect continuous for ongoing situations
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成進行式：描述「從過去一直持續到現在」的狀況（對照：過去的時間點 → 過去式）

grammar.q: I ___ the report yesterday afternoon, so you should have it already.
grammar.explain_zh: 有明確的過去時間點 yesterday afternoon → 用過去式 finished。時間點用過去式、持續到現在才用完成（進行）式。
grammar.point: Present perfect continuous for ongoing situations
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成進行式：描述「從過去一直持續到現在」的狀況（對照：過去的時間點 → 過去式）

grammar.q: "Sorry I'm late! ___ long?" — "No, just a few minutes."
grammar.explain_zh: 對方從過去等到現在（剛剛還在等），問「你等很久了嗎」用現在完成進行式 Have you been waiting long?
grammar.point: Present perfect continuous for ongoing situations
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成進行式：描述「從過去一直持續到現在」的狀況（對照：過去的時間點 → 過去式）

grammar.q: "The phone's ringing." — "Don't worry, ___ it."
grammar.explain_zh: 電話剛響，說話當下才決定去接（主動幫忙）→ will：I'll get it。I'm going to get it 文法沒錯，但 going to 表示事先就決定好的打算，用在這裡不自然；I'd get it 是假設語氣，要有條件才用；I get it 是「我懂了」，意思不對。
grammar.point: Future forms: will, going to, present continuous for plans
grammar.point_zh: 未來式：will、be going to、現在進行式表示已安排的計畫

grammar.q: "Are you free at 10 tomorrow?" — "Sorry, ___ the vendor then. It's been on my calendar all week."
grammar.explain_zh: 早就排進行事曆、時間確定的安排 → 現在進行式 I'm meeting。I'll meet 文法沒錯，但聽起來像是現在才決定要去見廠商，和「整週都排在行事曆上」矛盾；現在簡單式 I meet 多用在時刻表（The train leaves at 9.），講自己跟人約好的事不自然；I'd meet 是假設語氣，要有條件才用。
grammar.point: Future forms: will, going to, present continuous for plans
grammar.point_zh: 未來式：will、be going to、現在進行式表示已安排的計畫

grammar.q: Look at these numbers. We ___ (miss) our Q4 target unless something changes.
grammar.explain_zh: 看著眼前的數字（證據）做預測，最常用 be going to：We're going to miss… 主詞 we 要配 are，別漏掉 be 動詞。will miss 也可以接受。後面有 unless 條件，will miss 也很自然。
grammar.point: Future forms: will, going to, present continuous for plans
grammar.point_zh: 未來式：will、be going to、現在進行式表示已安排的計畫

grammar.q: I think the new plan ___ even by next summer.
grammar.explain_zh: I think + 一般預測 → will + 原形動詞（will break even）。is breaking 是已排定的安排，「打平」不是能排進行事曆的事；will 後面一定接原形，will breaks 多了 -s；is going break 少了 to（說 is going to break even 也對）。
grammar.point: Future forms: will, going to, present continuous for plans
grammar.point_zh: 未來式：will、be going to、現在進行式表示已安排的計畫

grammar.q: Sorry, I can't make Thursday. I ___ (fly) to Tokyo that morning — my flight's already booked.
grammar.explain_zh: 機票已經訂好、行程確定 → 現在進行式 I'm flying 最自然；I'm going to fly 也可以，I'll be flying（那時候正在飛）也是道地說法。I'll fly 聽起來像現在才決定，這裡不自然。
grammar.point: Future forms: will, going to, present continuous for plans
grammar.point_zh: 未來式：will、be going to、現在進行式表示已安排的計畫

grammar.q: Which sentence is correct?
options: I'm going to raise the headcount issue myself.
I going to raise the headcount issue myself.
I'm going raise the headcount issue myself.
I will to raise the headcount issue myself.
grammar.explain_zh: be going to + 原形動詞，三個部分都不能少：I'm（be 動詞）＋ going to ＋ raise。will 後面直接接原形，不加 to。
grammar.point: Future forms: will, going to, present continuous for plans
grammar.point_zh: 未來式：will、be going to、現在進行式表示已安排的計畫

grammar.q: Sign-ups ___ (grow) by 18% since we launched the new plan.
grammar.explain_zh: since + 過去時間點，表示「從那時到現在」→ 現在完成式 have grown。主詞 sign-ups 是複數，用 have。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式：「到現在」用完成式，「過去某個時間點」用過去式

grammar.q: We ___ the new pricing in September.
grammar.explain_zh: in September 是明確、已經結束的過去時間 → 過去式 launched。現在完成式不能和 in September、yesterday、last week 這類明確的過去時間連用（但可以說 since September）；have been launching 同理不行；had launch 形式錯誤。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式：「到現在」用完成式，「過去某個時間點」用過去式

grammar.q: I ___ on this team for three years now, so I know the numbers well.
grammar.explain_zh: for three years now 表示從三年前一直延續到現在（現在還在這個團隊）→ 現在完成式 have worked。worked 是過去式，表示那段經歷已經結束，不能和 now 連用；am working／work 都不能搭配 for three years 表示「到現在已經多久」。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式：「到現在」用完成式，「過去某個時間點」用過去式

grammar.q: My flight ___ (leave) Taipei three hours late last night.
grammar.explain_zh: last night 是明確的過去時間，事情已經結束 → 過去式 left。不能說 has left last night。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式：說得出「是哪個時間點」用過去式，重點在「到現在」用完成式

grammar.q: So far, the airline ___ (cancel) four flights because of the storm.
grammar.explain_zh: so far（到目前為止）表示從過去累積到現在 → 現在完成式。主詞 the airline 是單數，用 has。美式拼 canceled、英式拼 cancelled，都可以。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式：說得出「是哪個時間點」用過去式，重點在「到現在」用完成式

grammar.q: I ___ (be) at this airport since midnight, and I'm exhausted.
grammar.explain_zh: since midnight 表示從半夜一直到現在 → have been。中文「我從半夜就在這裡」沒有時態變化，但英文不能說 I am here since midnight。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式：說得出「是哪個時間點」用過去式，重點在「到現在」用完成式

grammar.q: Ticket prices ___ (go) up a lot since last summer.
grammar.explain_zh: since last summer → 現在完成式，主詞 prices 是複數，用 have gone；強調一路持續上漲也可以說 have been going up。注意不要寫成 have been gone：go 是不及物動詞，沒有被動，have been gone 只用在「離開多久了」（He's been gone for an hour）。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式：說得出「是哪個時間點」用過去式，重點在「到現在」用完成式

grammar.q: When ___ your new boarding pass?
grammar.explain_zh: When 問的是「哪個時間點」，答案一定是過去的某個時刻 → 過去式 did you get。現在完成式不能和 When 問句連用；you got 少了助動詞 did，是問句語序錯誤。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式：說得出「是哪個時間點」用過去式，重點在「到現在」用完成式

grammar.q: Which sentence is correct?
options: I've missed my connecting flight yesterday.
I've been missed my connecting flight yesterday.
I was miss my connecting flight yesterday.
I missed my connecting flight yesterday.
grammar.explain_zh: yesterday 是明確的過去時間 → 過去式 I missed。have missed 不能接 yesterday；have been missed 是被動，意思和形式都不對；was miss 混用了 be 動詞和原形。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式：說得出「是哪個時間點」用過去式，重點在「到現在」用完成式

grammar.q: My throat ___ (hurt) since we boarded the plane.
grammar.explain_zh: 從登機開始痛、到現在還在痛 → has been hurting（been 後面接 V-ing）。不要寫成 has been hurt：have/has been + 過去分詞是被動（被傷害），意思完全不同。主詞 my throat 是單數，用 has。
grammar.point: Present perfect continuous for ongoing situations
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成進行式：從過去開始、到現在還在持續的狀況（have/has been + V-ing）

grammar.q: I ___ (try) to call the airline for an hour, but nobody is picking up.
grammar.explain_zh: 從一小時前開始打、到現在還在打 → 現在完成進行式 have been trying（been 後面接 V-ing）。for an hour 表示持續多久，而且動作還沒結束，所以不用過去式 tried。注意不要寫成 have been tried：have been + 過去分詞是被動（被嘗試），意思不對。主詞是 I，用 have。
grammar.point: Present perfect continuous for ongoing situations
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成進行式：從過去開始、到現在還在持續的狀況（have/has been + V-ing）

grammar.q: We ___ in this line for forty minutes, and it still isn't moving.
grammar.explain_zh: for forty minutes 到現在還在排 → have been standing（been + V-ing）。have been stood 是「被動＋過去分詞」的錯誤組合；stood 表示已經結束；are standing 不能搭配 for forty minutes 表示持續多久。
grammar.point: Present perfect continuous for ongoing situations
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成進行式：從過去開始、到現在還在持續的狀況（have/has been + V-ing）

grammar.q: When I got to the meeting, the client ___ (already / leave).
grammar.explain_zh: 基準點是過去（我到會議的時候），客戶離開發生在更早之前 → had + p.p.。
grammar.point: Past perfect for the earlier past
grammar.point_zh: 過去完成式：比過去某個時間點更早發生的事

grammar.q: Ethan ___ (work) on the export feature since 9 a.m., and he's still at it.
grammar.explain_zh: since 9 a.m. 加上 still at it（現在還在做）→ 現在完成進行式 has been + V-ing。主詞 Ethan 是單數，用 has。
grammar.point: Past perfect for the earlier past
grammar.point_zh: 過去完成式：比過去某個時間點更早發生的事

grammar.q: By the time Priya found out on Thursday, Ethan ___ (already / promise) the client a new date.
grammar.explain_zh: 基準點是過去（Priya 週四發現的時候），答應新日期發生在更早之前，而且已經完成 → had + p.p.。
grammar.point: Past perfect for the earlier past
grammar.point_zh: 過去完成式：比過去某個時間點更早發生的事

grammar.q: By the end of last week, Legal ___ (review) only two of the five contracts.
grammar.explain_zh: 基準點是過去（上週結束時），在那之前完成的數量 → had + p.p.。
grammar.point: Past perfect for the earlier past
grammar.point_zh: 過去完成式：比過去某個時間點更早發生的事

grammar.q: Ethan was exhausted on Thursday because he ___ (work) on the feature all night.
grammar.explain_zh: 基準點是過去（週四很累），在那之前「整晚一直在做」→ had been + V-ing，強調持續的過程。had worked 文法上也對，但 all night 強調持續過程，用 had been working 最自然。
grammar.point: Past perfect for the earlier past
grammar.point_zh: 過去完成式：比過去某個時間點更早發生的事

grammar.q: "Where's Priya?" "She ___ to the client's office, so she won't be back until three."
grammar.explain_zh: 人已經去了、現在不在 → has gone。has been going 是「最近常常去」，不能說明她現在不在；goes 是習慣，也不對。
grammar.point: Past perfect for the earlier past
grammar.point_zh: 過去完成式：比過去某個時間點更早發生的事

grammar.q: I'd suggest that we ___ (move) the demo to Friday.
grammar.explain_zh: suggest that 後面的子句用原形動詞（move），不要寫 moves 或 to move。
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: Which question is a natural suggestion?
options: Why don't we ask the client for one more week?
Why we don't ask the client for one more week?
Why not we ask the client for one more week?
Why don't ask we the client for one more week?
grammar.explain_zh: 提出建議的固定語序是 Why don't we + 原形動詞。Why not 後面直接接原形動詞（Why not ask…?），不加 we。
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: I'd suggest ___ (check) with the team before we give the client a date.
grammar.explain_zh: suggest 後面直接接動作時用 V-ing（I'd suggest checking…），不能用 to check。
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: Under our policy, every new hire ___ (have to) finish security training in the first week.
grammar.explain_zh: 題目指定用 have to：規定要求、一定得做 → have to。主詞 every new hire 是單數，要用 has to。（也可以說 is supposed to，但語氣較弱，常暗示「規定是這樣，實際不一定做到」。）
grammar.point: Modals of obligation and advice: have to, be supposed to, had better
grammar.point_zh: 表示義務與建議：have to、be supposed to、had better

grammar.q: You look exhausted. You'd better ___ (go) home and rest.
grammar.explain_zh: had better（'d better）後面直接接原形動詞，不加 to：You'd better go。
grammar.point: Modals of obligation and advice: have to, be supposed to, had better
grammar.point_zh: 表示義務與建議：have to、be supposed to、had better

grammar.q: The update ___ (be supposed to) go out yesterday, but it was delayed.
grammar.explain_zh: yesterday 是過去，而且「本來應該、結果沒做到」→ was supposed to。主詞 the update 是單數，用 was。
grammar.point: Modals of obligation and advice: have to, be supposed to, had better
grammar.point_zh: 表示義務與建議：have to、be supposed to、had better

grammar.q: It's only a small bug, so the customer ___ (not / have to) reinstall the app.
grammar.explain_zh: 「不必」→ don't have to。主詞 the customer 是單數，要用 doesn't have to（不是 don't）。
grammar.point: Modals of obligation and advice: have to, be supposed to, had better
grammar.point_zh: 表示義務與建議：have to、be supposed to、had better

grammar.q: Under the contract, we ___ reply within 24 hours, but we took three days.
grammar.explain_zh: 合約規定要 24 小時內回覆，但實際花了三天 → 「本來應該、結果沒做到」用 were supposed to。後半句 but we took three days 是關鍵線索。
grammar.point: Modals of obligation and advice: have to, be supposed to, had better
grammar.point_zh: 表示義務與建議：have to、be supposed to、had better

grammar.q: Which sentence is a warning?
options: You'd better test it before the demo, or it might crash.
You don't have to test it before the demo.
You were supposed to test it yesterday.
grammar.explain_zh: had better 表示「最好…，不然會出事」，後面的 or it might crash 就是警告的後果。其他三句分別是「不必」、「本來應該」、「已經做過」。
grammar.point: Modals of obligation and advice: have to, be supposed to, had better
grammar.point_zh: 表示義務與建議：have to、be supposed to、had better

grammar.q: Since the new version launched, sign-ups ___ (grow) by 18%.
grammar.explain_zh: since 到現在、而且有具體數字（18%）→ 用 have + p.p.（have grown），不用進行式 have been growing。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式

grammar.q: The client ___ (cancel) three orders so far this month.
grammar.explain_zh: so far this month（到目前為止）＋次數（three orders）→ 現在完成式。主詞 the client 是單數，要用 has。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式

grammar.q: "When ___ the outage?" "Around 2 a.m."
grammar.explain_zh: When 問的是過去某個明確時間點 → 用過去式 did you notice，不用現在完成式；have you been noticed 是被動，意思也不對。
grammar.point: Present perfect vs past simple
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式

grammar.q: If the apartment ___ (have) a washing machine, we would sign the lease today.
grammar.explain_zh: 和現在事實相反（其實沒有洗衣機），if 子句用過去式 had。
grammar.point: Second conditional for hypothetical situations
grammar.point_zh: 第二條件句：談和現在不符、或不太可能發生的假設

grammar.q: If I ___ (be) you, I would ask for a one-year lease first.
grammar.explain_zh: If I were you 是給建議的固定說法；口語也可以說 was。
grammar.point: Second conditional for hypothetical situations
grammar.point_zh: 第二條件句：談和現在不符、或不太可能發生的假設

grammar.q: If the landlord lowered the rent, we ___ (stay) another year.
grammar.explain_zh: if 子句已經用過去式 lowered，主要子句用 would + 原形。
grammar.point: Second conditional for hypothetical situations
grammar.point_zh: 第二條件句：談和現在不符、或不太可能發生的假設

grammar.q: If the building ___ (allow) pets, my sister would move in tomorrow.
grammar.explain_zh: 主詞 the building 是第三人稱單數，但第二條件句的 if 子句用過去式，所以是 allowed，不是 allows。
grammar.point: Second conditional for hypothetical situations
grammar.point_zh: 第二條件句：談和現在不符、或不太可能發生的假設

grammar.q: We can't afford this place on our own, but if we ___ a roommate, we could.
grammar.explain_zh: 主要子句是 could（第二條件句），if 子句用過去式 found；if 子句不放 will 或 would。
grammar.point: Second conditional for hypothetical situations
grammar.point_zh: 第二條件句：談和現在不符、或不太可能發生的假設

grammar.q: The landlord says he will fix the heater this week. If he ___ it, we'll stay.
grammar.explain_zh: 這是很有可能發生的事（他說這週會修），主要子句是 we'll stay，所以用第一條件句：if + 現在式 fixes。
grammar.point: Second conditional for hypothetical situations
grammar.point_zh: 第二條件句：談和現在不符、或不太可能發生的假設

grammar.q: Why don't we ___ (ask) the landlord for a two-year lease?
grammar.explain_zh: Why don't we 後面接原形動詞。
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: I'd suggest that you ___ every room before you move in.
grammar.explain_zh: suggest that + 主詞 + 原形動詞（that 子句裡用原形）。
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: I'd suggest ___ (visit) the apartment at night to check the noise.
grammar.explain_zh: suggest 後面直接接動作時用 V-ing，不接 to V。
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: Why don't we ___ (ask) them for a service credit first?
grammar.explain_zh: Why don't we 後面接原形動詞 ask。
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: I'd suggest ___ (lock) in the current rate for two years.
grammar.explain_zh: suggest 後面沒有人、直接接動作時用 V-ing：locking，不是 to lock。也可以說 suggest (that) we lock。
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: How about ___ (offer) them a longer contract?
grammar.explain_zh: How about 後面接 V-ing：offering。
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: I'd suggest that our manager ___ (join) the next call.
grammar.explain_zh: suggest that + 人 + 原形：主詞 our manager 是單數也不加 s，用 join（英式也常說 should join）。
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: The vendor wants 15% more. I'd suggest ___ two other quotes before we reply.
grammar.explain_zh: suggest 後面直接接動作用 V-ing：getting。suggest 不接 to V，也不能直接接原形或過去式。
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: ___ we push the renewal call to Friday? Nobody has read the contract yet.
grammar.explain_zh: Why don't we + 原形 是友善的提議（我們要不要…）；其他選項是在真的問原因，意思不通。
grammar.point: Making suggestions: Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…
grammar.point_zh: 提出建議：Why don't we… / I'd suggest that…

grammar.q: ___ the heavy traffic, Mark arrived only five minutes late. (despite / although)
grammar.explain_zh: 後面是名詞 the heavy traffic（沒有動詞），所以用 Despite。although 後面要接完整句子。
grammar.point: Linking contrast: although, despite, whereas, however
grammar.point_zh: 表達對比：although、despite、whereas、however

grammar.q: ___ my new apartment is smaller, I really like the neighborhood. (although / despite)
grammar.explain_zh: 後面是完整句子 my new apartment is smaller（主詞＋動詞），所以用 Although。
grammar.point: Linking contrast: although, despite, whereas, however
grammar.point_zh: 表達對比：although、despite、whereas、however

grammar.q: ___ working here for only two weeks, Ana already knows everyone. (despite / although)
grammar.explain_zh: 後面接的是 working（V-ing），不是完整句子，所以用 Despite；Although 後面要接「主詞＋動詞」：Although she has worked here…。
grammar.point: Linking contrast: although, despite, whereas, however
grammar.point_zh: 表達對比：although、despite、whereas、however

grammar.q: Despite ___ (feel) sick, Priya finished the report on time.
grammar.explain_zh: despite 後面接名詞或 V-ing，所以用 feeling，不是 feel 或 she felt。
grammar.point: Linking contrast: although, despite, whereas, however
grammar.point_zh: 表達對比：although、despite、whereas、however

grammar.q: Kevin likes working from the office, ___ Priya prefers working from home.
grammar.explain_zh: 兩個人的習慣互相對比、後面是完整句子，用 whereas。despite／in spite of 不接句子；however 不能用逗號接在句子中間。
grammar.point: Linking contrast: although, despite, whereas, however
grammar.point_zh: 表達對比：although、despite、whereas、however

grammar.q: I've asked the landlord for my deposit twice. ___, he still hasn't sent it.
grammar.explain_zh: 前一句已經用句號結束，新句子開頭表示轉折、後面有逗號，用 However。Despite、Although、Whereas 都要和另一個子句或名詞連在同一句。
grammar.point: Linking contrast: although, despite, whereas, however
grammar.point_zh: 表達對比：although、despite、whereas、however

grammar.q: Excuse me, could you tell me where the fitting rooms ___ (be)?
grammar.explain_zh: 間接問句用直述句順序：the fitting rooms are。主詞是複數，所以用 are，放在句尾。
grammar.point: Indirect questions: Could you tell me where…
grammar.point_zh: 間接問句：Could you tell me where…（禮貌地問問題）

grammar.q: Could you tell me when ___ (did / you / buy) it? I need the date for the refund.
grammar.explain_zh: 間接問句不加 did：把 did 拿掉、主詞放前面，動詞自己變過去式：when you bought。不能寫 when did you buy。
grammar.point: Indirect questions: Could you tell me where…
grammar.point_zh: 間接問句：Could you tell me where…（禮貌地問問題）

grammar.q: Do you know ___ the purifier is still under warranty? It's been about a year.
grammar.explain_zh: 原本是 yes/no 問題（Is it still under warranty?），沒有疑問詞，所以要補 if 或 whether 接起來。
grammar.point: Indirect questions: Could you tell me where…
grammar.point_zh: 間接問句：Could you tell me where…（禮貌地問問題）

grammar.q: Could you tell me how much ___ (is / the restocking fee)?
grammar.explain_zh: 直接問句是 How much is the restocking fee?；放進間接問句後主詞要在動詞前面：how much the restocking fee is。
grammar.point: Indirect questions: Could you tell me where…
grammar.point_zh: 間接問句：Could you tell me where…（禮貌地問問題）

grammar.q: Can you tell me ___?
options: what time does the store close
what time is the store closes
grammar.explain_zh: 間接問句不加 does，用直述句順序「主詞＋動詞」：what time the store closes。
grammar.point: Indirect questions: Could you tell me where…
grammar.point_zh: 間接問句：Could you tell me where…（禮貌地問問題）

grammar.q: I was wondering ___ I could get store credit instead.
grammar.explain_zh: 原本是 yes/no 問題（Can I get store credit?），要用 if 或 whether 接起來。that 用在陳述事實，不能用來問問題。
grammar.point: Indirect questions: Could you tell me where…
grammar.point_zh: 間接問句：Could you tell me where…（禮貌地問問題）

grammar.q: I ___ (work) on this refund request all morning, and I still haven't heard back.
grammar.explain_zh: all morning 到現在還沒結束、人還在等回覆，重點是「一直在做」→ have been working 最自然。have worked 文法上也可以（work、live 這類動詞兩種都常見），但比較偏向在講「做過了、結果如何」；要清楚帶出「還在進行中」，就用完成進行式。
grammar.point: Present perfect continuous for ongoing situations
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成進行式：描述「從過去到現在一直在持續」的狀況

grammar.q: "Where's Kevin?" — "He ___ to the returns desk. He'll be back in a minute."
grammar.explain_zh: 重點是結果：人現在在那邊、不在這裡 → has gone。has been going 是「一直反覆去」（He's been going to the gym every day），這裡不合；had gone 要有一個過去的基準點（When I looked for him, he had gone…），這裡問的是現在；has been gone 後面不能直接接 to＋地點。
grammar.point: Present perfect continuous for ongoing situations
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成進行式：描述「從過去到現在一直在持續」的狀況

grammar.q: Which sentence is about how many have been completed so far, not about an activity that is still going on?
options: I've been handling returns all day.
I'd been handling returns when the manager called.
grammar.explain_zh: have handled + 數量 = 完成了幾件（結果）；have been handling + all day = 還在進行（過程）。第三句 had been handling 是同一組差別往過去移一格：在經理打來「之前」一直在處理，用過去完成進行式；had handled 則是那之前「完成了」幾件。
grammar.point: Present perfect continuous for ongoing situations
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成進行式：描述「從過去到現在一直在持續」的狀況

grammar.q: Please remember ___ (sign) the visitor log before you leave the building today.
grammar.explain_zh: today 還沒做完，是提醒對方「別忘了要去簽」→ remember to V：to sign。
grammar.point: Gerund vs infinitive: stop doing / stop to do, remember, try
grammar.point_zh: 動名詞 vs 不定詞：stop／remember／try 後面接 V-ing 或 to V，意思不一樣

grammar.q: I remember ___ (meet) Priya at the job fair last year. She asked really good questions.
grammar.explain_zh: last year 是已經發生的事，「記得做過」→ remember V-ing：meeting。
grammar.point: Gerund vs infinitive: stop doing / stop to do, remember, try
grammar.point_zh: 動名詞 vs 不定詞：stop／remember／try 後面接 V-ing 或 to V，意思不一樣

grammar.q: The printer kept jamming, so I tried ___ (use) a different paper tray, and it worked.
grammar.explain_zh: 換紙匣是「試一個方法看看有沒有效」，後面的 and it worked 就是實驗的結果 → try V-ing：using。
grammar.point: Gerund vs infinitive: stop doing / stop to do, remember, try
grammar.point_zh: 動名詞 vs 不定詞：stop／remember／try 後面接 V-ing 或 to V，意思不一樣

grammar.q: I'm trying ___ (finish) the security training before Friday, but the videos keep freezing.
grammar.explain_zh: 目標是「把訓練做完」，一直努力但遇到困難（影片一直卡住）→ try to V：to finish。
grammar.point: Gerund vs infinitive: stop doing / stop to do, remember, try
grammar.point_zh: 動名詞 vs 不定詞：stop／remember／try 後面接 V-ing 或 to V，意思不一樣

grammar.q: Halfway through the office tour, Sam stopped ___ the new hire to the head of IT.
grammar.explain_zh: Sam 是在導覽途中停下來，「為了去介紹」新人 → stop to V：stopped to introduce。stopped introducing 會變成「不再介紹」，和導覽的情境不合。
grammar.point: Gerund vs infinitive: stop doing / stop to do, remember, try
grammar.point_zh: 動名詞 vs 不定詞：stop／remember／try 後面接 V-ing 或 to V，意思不一樣

grammar.q: You can stop ___ every time you ask a question. Everyone was new once.
grammar.explain_zh: 意思是「不要再一直道歉了」，停掉正在做的習慣 → stop V-ing：stop apologizing。stop to apologize 是「停下來去道歉」，意思完全不同。
grammar.point: Gerund vs infinitive: stop doing / stop to do, remember, try
grammar.point_zh: 動名詞 vs 不定詞：stop／remember／try 後面接 V-ing 或 to V，意思不一樣

grammar.q: [Where is the IT help desk?] → Could you tell me ___?
grammar.answer: where the IT help desk is
grammar.explain_zh: 放進 Could you tell me 後面要改成直述句順序：主詞 the IT help desk 在前，is 移到最後。
grammar.point: Indirect questions: Could you tell me where…
grammar.point_zh: 間接問句：Could you tell me where…（禮貌地問問題）

grammar.q: [When does the security training start?] → Do you know ___?
grammar.explain_zh: 間接問句拿掉 does，動詞自己變化：主詞 the security training 是單數，所以 start 加 s → when the security training starts。
accept: when the security training will start
grammar.point: Indirect questions: Could you tell me where…
grammar.point_zh: 間接問句：Could you tell me where…（禮貌地問問題）

grammar.q: [Can I bring my own laptop?] → I was wondering ___.
grammar.answer: if I can bring my own laptop
accept: whether I can bring my own laptop
if I could bring my own laptop
whether I could bring my own laptop
grammar.explain_zh: 原本是 yes/no 問題，沒有疑問詞，要補 if 或 whether，再接直述句順序 I can bring。I was wondering 後面也常把 can 改成 could，更客氣。
grammar.point: Indirect questions: Could you tell me where…
grammar.point_zh: 間接問句：Could you tell me where…（禮貌地問問題）

grammar.q: The client's video froze and then disappeared from the screen. They ___ (I'm sure / lose) their connection.
grammar.explain_zh: 頭像變灰＋聲音斷掉是很明確的證據，「一定是」→ must have + p.p.。lose 的過去分詞是 lost。
grammar.point: Modals of deduction: must have, can't have, might have
grammar.point_zh: 推測過去：must have／can't have／might have + 過去分詞

grammar.q: Lena left the call before we discussed the budget, so she ___ (it's impossible / hear) the decision.
grammar.explain_zh: 她在討論預算前就離開了，所以「不可能聽到」→ can't have + p.p.：can't have heard。
grammar.point: Modals of deduction: must have, can't have, might have
grammar.point_zh: 推測過去：must have／can't have／might have + 過去分詞

grammar.q: I'm not sure why the client saw a blank window. Maya ___ (maybe / share) the wrong screen.
grammar.explain_zh: I'm not sure 表示不確定，只是「有可能」→ might have + p.p.：might have shared。
grammar.point: Modals of deduction: must have, can't have, might have
grammar.point_zh: 推測過去：must have／can't have／might have + 過去分詞

grammar.q: There was a loud echo during the whole call. Someone ___ (I'm sure / forget) to put on their headphones.
grammar.explain_zh: 整通電話都有回音，幾乎可以確定有人沒戴耳機 → must have + p.p.。forget 的過去分詞是 forgotten，不是 forgot。
grammar.point: Modals of deduction: must have, can't have, might have
grammar.point_zh: 推測過去：must have／can't have／might have + 過去分詞

grammar.q: Mark joined the call right on time, so he ___ the wrong link. The problem must be something else.
grammar.explain_zh: 他準時進了會議，所以「不可能拿到錯的連結」→ can't have + p.p.。must have gotten 意思相反；might get 和 can't get 講的是現在或未來，不是推測過去。
grammar.point: Modals of deduction: must have, can't have, might have
grammar.point_zh: 推測過去：must have／can't have／might have + 過去分詞

grammar.q: I don't know why Amy dropped off. Her laptop battery ___, or maybe her Wi-Fi went down.
grammar.explain_zh: 後面接 or maybe 列出另一個可能，表示說話者不確定 → might have + p.p.。must have 太肯定；might died 少了 have。
grammar.point: Modals of deduction: must have, can't have, might have
grammar.point_zh: 推測過去：must have／can't have／might have + 過去分詞

grammar.q: Please remember ___ (unmute) yourself before you start your update on Thursday.
grammar.explain_zh: Thursday 還沒到，是提醒「別忘了要去做」→ remember to V：to unmute。
grammar.point: Gerund vs infinitive: stop doing / stop to do, remember, try
grammar.point_zh: 動名詞 vs 不定詞：stop／remember／try 後面接 V-ing 或 to V，意思不一樣

grammar.q: My video kept freezing, so I tried ___ (turn) off my camera, and the audio got much better.
grammar.explain_zh: 關掉鏡頭是「試一個方法看看有沒有效」，後面 the audio got much better 就是結果 → try V-ing：turning。
grammar.point: Gerund vs infinitive: stop doing / stop to do, remember, try
grammar.point_zh: 動名詞 vs 不定詞：stop／remember／try 後面接 V-ing 或 to V，意思不一樣

grammar.q: Halfway through her presentation, Maya stopped ___ (answer) a question from the chat, and then she went back to her slides.
grammar.explain_zh: 她是在簡報中途「停下來，為了去回答」聊天室的問題，接著又回到投影片 → stop to V：to answer。stopped answering 是「不再回答」，和後面 went back to her slides 的語意不合。
grammar.point: Gerund vs infinitive: stop doing / stop to do, remember, try
grammar.point_zh: 動名詞 vs 不定詞：stop／remember／try 後面接 V-ing 或 to V，意思不一樣

grammar.q: At this hotel, rooms ___ (clean) every day between 10 a.m. and 2 p.m.
grammar.explain_zh: every day 是固定流程，房間是「被打掃」→ 現在式被動 are + p.p.：are cleaned。
grammar.point: Passive voice in reports and processes
grammar.point_zh: 被動語態：說明流程與寫報告

grammar.q: Last night, two guests ___ (move) to another hotel because we were overbooked.
grammar.explain_zh: Last night 是過去時間，客人是「被安排」換飯店 → was/were + p.p.；主詞 two guests 是複數，用 were moved。
grammar.point: Passive voice in reports and processes
grammar.point_zh: 被動語態：說明流程與寫報告

grammar.q: Good news! Your room ___ (just / upgrade) to a suite.
grammar.explain_zh: just 表示剛處理好、結果到現在 → has/have + been + p.p.；主詞 your room 是單數，用 has just been upgraded（just 放在 has 後面）。美式英文也常說 was just upgraded。
grammar.point: Passive voice in reports and processes
grammar.point_zh: 被動語態：說明流程與寫報告

grammar.q: At most hotels, a hold for incidental charges ___ (place) on your card at check-in.
grammar.explain_zh: At most hotels … at check-in 是每次入住都一樣的固定流程，主詞 a hold 單數、是「被放上」→ is placed。
grammar.point: Passive voice in reports and processes
grammar.point_zh: 被動語態：說明流程與寫報告

grammar.q: From our incident report: "On Monday, the guest's booking ___ by mistake."
grammar.explain_zh: 訂房是「被取消」，On Monday 是過去時間 → was + p.p.：was canceled。canceled、has canceled 是主動；was cancel 少了 -ed。
grammar.point: Passive voice in reports and processes
grammar.point_zh: 被動語態：說明流程與寫報告

grammar.q: So far this month, 35 complaints ___ about the Wi-Fi.
grammar.explain_zh: So far this month 是「到現在為止」的結果，投訴是「被收到」→ have been + p.p.：have been received。have received 是主動，意思變成「投訴收到了東西」。
grammar.point: Passive voice in reports and processes
grammar.point_zh: 被動語態：說明流程與寫報告

grammar.q: (Where is the shuttle bus?) Could you tell me ___?
grammar.explain_zh: 間接問句要改回直述句的順序：主詞在前、動詞在後 → where the shuttle bus is，不是 where is the shuttle bus。
grammar.point: Indirect questions: Could you tell me where…
grammar.point_zh: 間接問句：Could you tell me where…

grammar.q: (What time does breakfast start?) Do you know ___?
grammar.explain_zh: 拿掉助動詞 does，動詞改回 starts（主詞 breakfast 是單數）→ what time breakfast starts。
grammar.point: Indirect questions: Could you tell me where…
grammar.point_zh: 間接問句：Could you tell me where…

grammar.q: (Is the gym open 24 hours?) Could you tell me ___?
grammar.answer: if the gym is open 24 hours
accept: whether the gym is open 24 hours
if the gym is open twenty-four hours
whether the gym is open twenty-four hours
grammar.explain_zh: Yes/No 問題變成間接問句要加 if 或 whether，再用直述句順序 → if the gym is open 24 hours。
grammar.point: Indirect questions: Could you tell me where…
grammar.point_zh: 間接問句：Could you tell me where…

grammar.q: (Where is the latest sales file?) Could you tell me ___?
grammar.answer: where the latest sales file is
grammar.explain_zh: 有 be 動詞：把 is 移到主詞 the latest sales file 後面。
grammar.point: Indirect questions: Could you tell me where…
grammar.point_zh: 間接問句：Could you tell me where…（把問題放進客氣的句子裡）

grammar.q: (What time does the dashboard update?) Do you know ___?
grammar.explain_zh: 拿掉 does，三單的 s 加回動詞：the dashboard updates。
grammar.point: Indirect questions: Could you tell me where…
grammar.point_zh: 間接問句：Could you tell me where…（把問題放進客氣的句子裡）

grammar.q: (Why did the numbers change last week?) Could you explain ___?
grammar.answer: why the numbers changed last week
grammar.explain_zh: 拿掉 did，過去式加回動詞：the numbers changed。
grammar.point: Indirect questions: Could you tell me where…
grammar.point_zh: 間接問句：Could you tell me where…（把問題放進客氣的句子裡）

grammar.q: (Has the data team finished the migration?) Do you know ___?
grammar.answer: if the data team has finished the migration
accept: whether the data team has finished the migration
if the data team has finished it
whether the data team has finished it
grammar.explain_zh: Yes/No 問題前面加 if／whether，has 放回主詞後面：the data team has finished。
grammar.point: Indirect questions: Could you tell me where…
grammar.point_zh: 間接問句：Could you tell me where…（把問題放進客氣的句子裡）

grammar.q: (Do the two teams share a calendar?) I was wondering ___.
grammar.answer: if the two teams share a calendar
accept: whether the two teams share a calendar
grammar.explain_zh: Yes/No 問題加 if；拿掉 do，主詞是複數 the two teams，所以動詞用 share，不加 s。
grammar.point: Indirect questions: Could you tell me where…
grammar.point_zh: 間接問句：Could you tell me where…（把問題放進客氣的句子裡）

grammar.q: I'd like to know ___.
options: how long will the handoff take
how long the handoff will take
how long does the handoff take
how long the handoff does take
grammar.explain_zh: I'd like to know 後面是間接問句，要用直述句順序：主詞 the handoff 在前，will take 在後。其他選項都保留了問句倒裝或多餘的 does。
grammar.point: Indirect questions: Could you tell me where…
grammar.point_zh: 間接問句：Could you tell me where…（把問題放進客氣的句子裡）

grammar.q: The app keeps crashing. Have you tried ___ (restart) it? That sometimes fixes it.
grammar.explain_zh: try + V-ing＝試試看某個方法有沒有用；這裡是建議一個解決辦法。
grammar.point: Gerund vs infinitive: stop doing / stop to do, remember, try
grammar.point_zh: 動名詞 vs 不定詞：stop／remember／try 接 V-ing 或 to V 意思不同

grammar.q: Please remember ___ (copy) the data team on the email before you send it.
grammar.explain_zh: remember + to V＝記得要去做（還沒做的事）；before you send it 表示是之後要做的。
grammar.point: Gerund vs infinitive: stop doing / stop to do, remember, try
grammar.point_zh: 動名詞 vs 不定詞：stop／remember／try 接 V-ing 或 to V 意思不同

grammar.q: On my way to the meeting, I stopped ___ (grab) a coffee, so I was a few minutes late.
grammar.explain_zh: stop + to V＝停下來去做另一件事；他停下腳步是為了買咖啡。
grammar.point: Gerund vs infinitive: stop doing / stop to do, remember, try
grammar.point_zh: 動名詞 vs 不定詞：stop／remember／try 接 V-ing 或 to V 意思不同

grammar.q: "We'll finish the testing by Friday." → Two weeks ago, Lena said they ___ the testing by that Friday.
grammar.explain_zh: will 後移成 would，後面接原形 finish。
grammar.point: Reported speech and backshift
grammar.point_zh: 間接引述與時態後移：He said (that)… 後面的時態往過去推一格

grammar.q: "The client is happy with the first design." → At last month's review, Mark told us the client ___ happy with the first design, but they've since asked for major changes.
grammar.explain_zh: is 後移成 was；主詞 the client 是單數，所以用 was。
grammar.point: Reported speech and backshift
grammar.point_zh: 間接引述與時態後移：He said (that)… 後面的時態往過去推一格

grammar.q: "We have fixed the login bug." → Last month, the developers said they ___ the login bug, but it came back this week.
grammar.explain_zh: 現在完成式 have fixed 後移成過去完成式 had fixed（had + p.p.）。
grammar.point: Reported speech and backshift
grammar.point_zh: 間接引述與時態後移：He said (that)… 後面的時態往過去推一格

grammar.q: "I can't join the call on Thursday." → Last month, Priya said she ___ join the call that Thursday.
grammar.explain_zh: can't 後移成 couldn't，後面接原形 join。
grammar.point: Reported speech and backshift
grammar.point_zh: 間接引述與時態後移：He said (that)… 後面的時態往過去推一格

grammar.q: "We are testing the new checkout page." → Last month, the QA team told me they ___ the new checkout page. It went live last week.
grammar.explain_zh: 現在進行式 are testing 後移成過去進行式；主詞 they 是複數，所以用 were testing。
grammar.point: Reported speech and backshift
grammar.point_zh: 間接引述與時態後移：He said (that)… 後面的時態往過去推一格

grammar.q: "I don't have access to the dashboard." → Sara said she ___ access to the dashboard, so I asked IT to help her. (She can log in now.)
grammar.explain_zh: don't have 後移成 didn't have。她現在已經可以登入了，所以不能保留現在式 doesn't have；hasn't had、won't have 的時態都不對。
grammar.point: Reported speech and backshift
grammar.point_zh: 間接引述與時態後移：He said (that)… 後面的時態往過去推一格

grammar.q: Every Friday, the weekly reports ___ (send) to the whole team.
grammar.explain_zh: Every Friday 是固定流程，用現在式被動；主詞 the weekly reports 是複數，所以是 are sent。
grammar.point: Passive voice in reports and processes
grammar.point_zh: 被動語態：報告和流程裡的「被做了什麼」

grammar.q: Last night, the main server ___ (update) twice by the IT team.
grammar.explain_zh: Last night 是過去時間，用過去式被動；主詞 the main server 是單數，而且是被 IT 團隊更新，所以是 was updated。
grammar.point: Passive voice in reports and processes
grammar.point_zh: 被動語態：報告和流程裡的「被做了什麼」

grammar.q: So far, three of the five bugs ___ (fix), and the other two are next.
grammar.explain_zh: So far（到目前為止）用現在完成式被動；主詞 three of the five bugs 是複數，所以是 have been fixed。
grammar.point: Passive voice in reports and processes
grammar.point_zh: 被動語態：報告和流程裡的「被做了什麼」

grammar.q: "Why don't you take short breaks?" → The doctor suggested ___ (take) short breaks every hour.
grammar.explain_zh: suggest 後面直接接動作時用 V-ing：suggested taking。
grammar.point: Reporting verbs: suggest, recommend, insist on, deny
grammar.point_zh: 轉述動詞：suggest、recommend、insist on、deny 後面接什麼

grammar.q: "You should see a physical therapist." → She recommended that he ___ (see) a physical therapist twice a week.
grammar.explain_zh: recommend that + 人 + 原形動詞；主詞是 he 也用原形 see，不是 sees 或 saw（英式也可說 should see）。
grammar.point: Reporting verbs: suggest, recommend, insist on, deny
grammar.point_zh: 轉述動詞：suggest、recommend、insist on、deny 後面接什麼

grammar.q: "I'm driving you to the clinic. No arguments." → My wife insisted ___ (drive) me to the clinic.
grammar.explain_zh: insist 後面要加 on，再接 V-ing：insisted on driving。
grammar.point: Reporting verbs: suggest, recommend, insist on, deny
grammar.point_zh: 轉述動詞：suggest、recommend、insist on、deny 後面接什麼

grammar.q: "I didn't lift anything heavy at the gym." → Mark denied ___ (lift) anything heavy at the gym.
grammar.explain_zh: deny 後面接 V-ing：denied lifting（也可用 having lifted 強調是之前的事）。
grammar.point: Reporting verbs: suggest, recommend, insist on, deny
grammar.point_zh: 轉述動詞：suggest、recommend、insist on、deny 後面接什麼

grammar.q: "Don't carry a heavy bag for a while." → The physical therapist recommended ___ (not / carry) a heavy bag for a while.
grammar.explain_zh: recommend + V-ing 的否定是把 not 放在 V-ing 前面：recommended not carrying。
grammar.point: Reporting verbs: suggest, recommend, insist on, deny
grammar.point_zh: 轉述動詞：suggest、recommend、insist on、deny 後面接什麼

grammar.q: "We need to take an X-ray before I give you anything stronger." → The doctor insisted ___ an X-ray before giving me anything stronger.
grammar.explain_zh: insist 後面一定要有 on，on 是介系詞所以接 V-ing：insisted on taking。to take、taking 少了 on；on take 動詞沒有加 -ing。
grammar.point: Reporting verbs: suggest, recommend, insist on, deny
grammar.point_zh: 轉述動詞：suggest、recommend、insist on、deny 後面接什麼

grammar.q: "When does the clinic open?" → Could you tell me when ___ (the clinic / open)?
grammar.explain_zh: 拿掉 does，把時態加回動詞：the clinic opens（單數主詞加 -s）。
grammar.point: Indirect questions: Could you tell me where…
grammar.point_zh: 間接問句：Could you tell me… 後面改成直述句順序

grammar.q: "What did the doctor say?" → Do you know what ___ (the doctor / say)?
grammar.explain_zh: 拿掉 did，把過去式加回動詞：the doctor said。
grammar.point: Indirect questions: Could you tell me where…
grammar.point_zh: 間接問句：Could you tell me… 後面改成直述句順序

grammar.q: "Is the pharmacy open on Sundays?" → Do you know ___ (the pharmacy / be) open on Sundays?
grammar.explain_zh: Yes/No 問句要加 if（或 whether），再用直述句順序：if the pharmacy is。
grammar.point: Indirect questions: Could you tell me where…
grammar.point_zh: 間接問句：Could you tell me… 後面改成直述句順序

translate.zh: 不知道你能不能在開會前幫我看一下簡報。
translate.en: I was wondering if you could review my slides before the meeting.

translate.zh: 我們的通話可以改到下午三點嗎？
translate.en: Would it be possible to move our call to 3 p.m.?

translate.zh: 可以麻煩你把最新版本寄給我嗎？
translate.en: Would you mind sending me the latest version?

translate.zh: 我想先提出一個問題：這個時程可能不太可行。
translate.en: I'd like to flag an issue first: this timeline might not be feasible.
alt: I want to flag an issue first: this schedule may not be feasible.

translate.zh: 如果我們縮小範圍，週五還是可以上線。
translate.en: If we reduce the scope, we can still launch on Friday.
alt: If we cut the scope, we can still go live on Friday.

translate.zh: 不知道我們能不能把會議延到下週一？
translate.en: I was wondering if we could push back the meeting to next Monday.
alt: I was wondering if we could push the meeting back to next Monday.

translate.zh: 到目前為止我們完成了五個里程碑中的三個。
translate.en: We've completed three of the five milestones so far.

translate.zh: 我們上週四完成了第二個里程碑。
translate.en: We completed the second milestone last Thursday.

translate.zh: 客戶核准設計了沒？
translate.en: Has the client signed off on the design yet?

translate.zh: 整體來說，這個專案仍按計畫進行。
translate.en: Overall, the project is still on track.
alt: Overall, the project is still on schedule.

translate.zh: 我們已經完成了付款流程。
translate.en: We've finished the payment flow.
alt: We have completed the payment flow.
We've completed the payment flow.

translate.zh: 我們上週二推出了新版本。
translate.en: We rolled out the new version last Tuesday.
alt: We released the new version last Tuesday.

translate.zh: 法務還沒核准合約，這是我們目前最大的卡關點。
translate.en: Legal hasn't signed off on the contract yet, and that's our biggest blocker right now.
alt: Legal hasn't approved the contract yet, which is our biggest blocker at the moment.

translate.zh: 退款頁面會順延到下週，我明天會再跟供應商追蹤。
translate.en: The refund pages will carry over to next week, and I'll follow up with the vendor again tomorrow.
alt: The refund pages will be carried over to next week. I'll follow up with the supplier tomorrow.
The refund pages will carry over to next week, and I'll follow up with the vendor tomorrow.

translate.zh: 他們什麼時候寄出檔案的？→ 你知道他們什麼時候寄出檔案的嗎？
translate.en: When did they send the file? → Do you know when they sent the file?

translate.zh: 儀表板正常嗎？→ 你知道儀表板是不是正常嗎？
translate.en: Is the dashboard working? → Do you know if the dashboard is working?

translate.zh: 你知道資料團隊什麼時候會更新儀表板嗎？
translate.en: Do you know when the data team will update the dashboard?
alt: Do you know when the data team is going to update the dashboard?

translate.zh: 可以告訴我這個檔案是不是最新的版本嗎？
translate.en: Could you tell me if this file is the latest version?
alt: Could you tell me whether this file is the latest version?
Could you tell me if this is the latest version of the file?

translate.zh: Mei 已經做完三份報告了，但她從今天早上就一直在處理第四份。
translate.en: Mei has already finished three reports, but she has been working on the fourth one since this morning.
alt: Mei has already finished three reports, but she's been working on the fourth since this morning.

translate.zh: 到目前為止，已經有十二個需求被延到下一個衝刺週期。
translate.en: So far, twelve requests have been carried over to the next sprint.
alt: So far, twelve requests have been moved to the next sprint.

translate.zh: 「首頁完成了。」→ 設計師說首頁已經完成了。
translate.en: "The homepage is finished." → The designers said the homepage was finished.

translate.zh: 「我們星期五前會把測試收尾。」→ Lena 說他們會在星期五前把測試收尾。
translate.en: "We'll wrap up testing by Friday." → Lena said they would wrap up testing by Friday.

translate.zh: 「我們解決了登入的錯誤。」→ 工程師說他們已經解決了登入的錯誤。
translate.en: "We've sorted out the login bug." → The developers said they had sorted out the login bug.

translate.zh: 「我們正在做手機版。」→ 他們跟我說他們正在做手機版。
translate.en: "We're working on the mobile version." → They told me they were working on the mobile version.

translate.zh: Lena 說他們會在星期五前完成測試。
translate.en: Lena said they would finish testing by Friday.
alt: Lena said that they would finish testing by Friday.
Lena said they would finish the testing by Friday.
Lena told us they would finish testing by Friday.
Lena said they would wrap up testing by Friday.

translate.zh: 客戶上週說他們對新設計很滿意。
translate.en: Last week, the client said they were happy with the new design.
alt: The client said last week that they were happy with the new design.
Last week the client said that they were happy with the new design.
The client told us last week that they were happy with the new design.

translate.zh: 可以告訴我預算申請什麼時候會被核准嗎？
translate.en: Could you tell me when the budget request will be approved?
alt: Could you tell me when the budget request is going to be approved?
Can you tell me when the budget request will be approved?

translate.zh: 我們已經寫完兩份報告了，但從星期一開始就一直在做第三份。
translate.en: We have already finished two reports, but we have been working on the third one since Monday.
alt: We've already finished two reports, but we've been working on the third one since Monday.
We have already finished two reports, but we've been working on the third since Monday.

translate.zh: 「你何不每小時走一走？」→ 醫生建議每小時散步一下。
translate.en: "Why don't you take a short walk every hour?" → The doctor suggested taking a short walk every hour.

translate.zh: 「你應該開始做物理治療。」→ 她建議他每週做兩次物理治療。
translate.en: "You should start physical therapy." → She recommended that he start physical therapy twice a week.

translate.zh: 「我載你去，不准拒絕。」→ Mia 堅持要載他去診所。
translate.en: "I'm driving you there. No arguments." → Mia insisted on driving him to the clinic.

translate.zh: 「我在健身房沒搬任何東西。」→ Daniel 否認在健身房搬過重物。
translate.en: "I didn't lift anything at the gym." → Daniel denied lifting anything heavy at the gym.

translate.zh: 醫生建議我每小時起來走一走。
translate.en: The doctor suggested that I get up and walk around every hour.
alt: The doctor suggested I get up and walk around every hour.
The doctor suggested getting up and walking around every hour.
The doctor recommended that I get up and walk around every hour.
The doctor recommended getting up and walking around every hour.

translate.zh: 我太太堅持要載我去診所。
translate.en: My wife insisted on driving me to the clinic.
alt: My wife insisted on taking me to the clinic.

translate.zh: 你知道那家診所週末有沒有看診嗎？
translate.en: Do you know if that clinic is open on weekends?
alt: Do you know whether that clinic is open on weekends?
Do you know if the clinic is open on weekends?
Do you know if that clinic sees patients on weekends?
Do you know whether the clinic is open on weekends?

translate.zh: 我已經做過兩次物理治療了，而且從星期一開始每天早上都在做伸展。
translate.en: I've already had two physical therapy sessions, and I've been doing stretches every morning since Monday.
alt: I have already had two physical therapy sessions, and I have been doing stretches every morning since Monday.
I've already done two physical therapy sessions, and I've been stretching every morning since Monday.
I've already had physical therapy twice, and I've been doing stretches every morning since Monday.
